text:
Leo: Heads-up — getting a bunch of prefix-cache hit-rate alerts over the last 6h, looks pretty noisy. Anyone know the canonical dashboard/panel to look at? wondering if we should tune threshold or mute tiny prefixes.

Priya: Dashboard lives here: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/kv-prefix/hit-rate-overview?orgId=1 — panels I usually check: 'prefix_hit_rate_over_time' (panel 42) and 'prefix_volume_heatmap' (panel 88). Set time range to 6h and group by prefix.

Priya: Quick PromQL I use to get the weighted hit rate for a prefix:
```
(sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) ) / (sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_prefix_lookups_total[5m])) )
```

Raj: Alert rule is in infra repo: infra/alerts/kv_prefix_hit.yaml. Current threshold is 0.6 and alerts include tiny prefixes which causes churn. I opened a PR to tweak + add a volume gate: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812 — proposes threshold -> 0.55 and require lookups_total > 2000 over 5m. @Elaine can you review when you have a moment?

cache-bot: ALERT fired: prefix-cache-low-hit (prefix=web-session) hit_rate=0.52 threshold=0.6 lookups=3100 — fired at 1952345600.

Mike: Strong +1 on volume gating. Also want to consider alerting on p95 hit-rate rather than instant ratio so transient drops don't spam. Example additional condition:
```
avg_over_time((sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(prefix) (rate(kv_prefix_lookups_total[5m]))) [15m:5m]) < 0.6
```
and only if sum(rate(...[5m])) > 2000

Elaine: Looks reasonable. Will take a look at PR #812 tomorrow morning. Can we add a comment documenting why 2000 was chosen (tradeoff vs sensitivity)? I'll also run it against last 30 days to check false positives.

Priya: Also, when investigating a specific prefix drop, check traces/logs: Jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=kv&tags=prefix:<prefix> and logs in Kibana: https://logs.redwood.com/app/kibana#/discover with query `service:kv AND prefix:"<prefix>" AND status:miss`.

Raj: Updated PR with test and a note about 2000 threshold + example queries to reproduce the noise. Assigned to eng-platform and requested review from Elaine.

Leo: Thanks all — will follow up after review. If PR lands, let's roll out the change during quiet hours and watch for suppressed alerts. :thumbsup:
